W-01.note: odd-one-out on epistemic axis: successive/unremarkable/coeval are factual-descriptive, only 'conjectural' rates the STATUS of a claim

W-02.note: three are temporal-distribution (cyclical/protracted/concentrated), 'reversible' is about direction of change

W-03.note: near-synonym pair: floating/hanging are interchangeable so neither can be a unique key; of halted/deferred, deferred is the precise one

W-04.note: hedging: provisional/incontrovertible/representative all rate evidence, 'generous' is off-axis; among the three the qualified one keys

W-05.note: weak hedging read on 'modest'; uniform/recent/seasonal are all legal

W-06.note: specificity: perceptible is the precisely-scaled term; sensitive/considerable/reasonable are vague magnitude words

W-07.note: 'parallels' is the only non-causal relation, but the axis is not clean

W-08.note: settles/determines are interchangeable so pair-eliminate; between dissolves/separates the extended abstract sense is dissolves

W-09.note: odd-one-out on authority: retrospective/provisional/unofficial all diminish the record, 'verbatim transcripts' alone asserts full fidelity

W-10.note: anecdotal is the stock SAT weak-evidence term; three options sit on different axes

W-11.note: dictionary-sense item (economy): key is the extended/abstract sense 'sparing use of means', not the concrete literal ones

W-14.note: curbed/halted are an interchangeable stopping pair, pair-eliminate; verified is stronger than the neutral observational 'recorded'

W-15.note: three are outward acts (chronicle/publicize/instruct); 'discern' is the only perceptual verb - observation-verb channel

W-16.note: framework/structure are interchangeable, pair-eliminate; composition is the precise one of the remaining two

W-17.note: dictionary-sense item (temperate): abstract sense 'moderate and restrained' over the literal climate sense

W-18.note: formulaic is the only stylistic-pejorative among three resource words; low confidence

W-19.note: dictionary-sense item (homely): the literary/extended reading 'plain and unadorned'

W-20.note: three concern fidelity to the source (literal/exacting/faithful); 'idiomatic' is the odd one, about the target language

W-21.note: hedging: justifies/disputes/certifies are strong stances, 'modifies' is the qualified one

W-22.note: cross-item cluster with W-11/W-30/W-32 (economy senses); the sparing-use sense maps to frugality

W-23.note: curated/edited are interchangeable, pair-eliminate; 'staged' is the loaded extended sense

W-24.note: accommodate is the only non-agricultural verb; axis unclear

W-25.note: dictionary-sense item (address): the rare/extended sense 'skill in handling situations'

W-26.note: register outlier: 'dispositive' is far rarer and more technical than contested/premonitory/ubiquitous

W-27.note: duplicate/reorganize/sharpen all act on the thing itself; 'overshadow' alone is a relation of relative prominence

W-29.note: metaphorical 'a form of insurance' is a stock key; guessing

W-30.note: frugality/spareness split on person-virtue vs quality-of-a-thing; an abstract noun slot takes spareness

W-31.note: dictionary-sense item (color): figurative 'bias the impression of' over literal pigment/blush senses

W-32.note: economy cluster again (see W-11/W-22/W-30): thrift is the sparing-use member

W-33.note: register: incomplete/premature/unwarranted are ordinary criticisms, 'circular' is the named logical fallacy

W-34.note: Financial gains/Gradual accumulations are near-interchangeable accumulation readings, pair-eliminate; the extended sense is 'sudden bursts of insight'

W-35.note: hedging plus the temperate cluster (W-17/W-50): 'moderate' is the tempering verb among provoke/harmonize/toughen

W-36.note: amplified/delayed/nullified all modify magnitude or timing of an effect; 'replicated' is the odd one, reproduction of the effect

W-37.note: resisted/invited are reactions, recorded is observational; 'anticipated' alone is temporal foresight, the stock frame for a scholarly subject

W-38.note: 'settle' is the only option with a live extended sense (settle a question); locate/separate/enlarge are literal

W-39.note: reversible recurs from W-02 so likely a distractor here; accidental picked on a weak chance-vs-law axis

W-40.note: three options deflate the act (concession/oversight/maneuver); 'a genuine prediction' is the odd epistemic one

W-41.note: candor/contrition are a sincerity pair; between the two deflationary options I have no basis

W-43.note: proclaim/enroll are acts, detect/estimate epistemic; 'estimate' is the hedged quantitative one - observation-verb channel

W-44.note: commemorate/manufacture are off-axis; between contest and legitimize, legitimize is the stock key for status-of-a-claim frames

W-45.note: decisive/essential are interchangeable 'crucial' readings, pair-eliminate; of the rest 'censorious' is the register outlier

W-46.note: negotiation/accommodation are a mutual pair which should eliminate both; picked the compromise term anyway, so this is a guess

W-47.note: idiosyncratic is the stock key word; no real channel

W-48.note: 'settled' recurs across W-08/W-38/W-48; extended-sense read only

W-49.note: defer/arrest/obscure are all suppression verbs, 'offset' alone is counterbalancing - odd one out

W-50.note: dictionary-sense item (temperate): 'measured' is the abstract sense; lukewarm/climate/teetotal are the literal ones

W-52.note: reward/advertise/enforce act on behaviour; 'measure' is the observation verb - same channel as W-14/W-15/W-43
